targetAudience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on
topic: Al-Baqarah 2:186: Allah is near and responds to the one who calls
coreInsight: Al-Baqarah 2:186 says Allah is near and responds to the one who calls upon Him, so we can ask Him directly, today.
selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

script.onScreen: Feeling unheard? / This ayah is for you.
REFLECTION / Ask in your own words, in any language · Ask for the small things, too · Keep asking, and keep trusting
Make one du'a right now. / Send this to someone who needs it

caption:
If you feel like no one is listening, sit with Al-Baqarah 2:186 for a moment.

A reflection for today:
→ ask in your own words, in any language
→ ask for the small things, too
→ keep asking, and keep trusting

Send this to someone who needs it today.

📖 Sources
• Qur'an 2:186 (tr. Saheeh International) — quran.com/2/186
Full text: And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided
